range.endpoint_anchor: muzzle fraction of L: 0.33 = 0 (neutral base); span 0.20 -> -100 = 0.13, +100 = 0.53 (preset value = 100 x (species ratio - 0.33) / 0.20)

semantics: Rostrum block length along the head axis: muzzle fraction of total skull length L (nose tip to occiput). The primary canid/felid length axis - cat pins the short end (-65), dog/wolf the long end. A bone-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
